areas.title: Documentation
areas.text: We help prepare the export documentation your market requires. Requirements vary by destination country, so we confirm these with you during the quote.

areas.title: Shipping

faqs.question: Do you ship vehicles to my country?
faqs.answer: We can help coordinate export and shipping to many destinations. Final shipping availability and cost depend on your destination port, so please contact us with your location.

faqs.question: Can you source a vehicle that is not in your inventory?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell us the brand, model, year, budget and destination using the Request a Car form, and we will look for options in China's market.

faqs.question: What does the listed price include?
faqs.answer: The listed price is the asking price for the vehicle only. Shipping, taxes, import duties and other landed costs are quoted separately and depend on the destination.

faqs.question: How long does export take?
faqs.answer: Export time depends on the vehicle, documentation requirements and destination. We confirm an estimated timeline when you request a quote.

about.title: About — China Used Car Export
about.description: China Used Car Export is a commercial platform for sourcing used and near-new vehicles from China for export buyers.
paragraphs: China Used Auto Hub is a commercial platform for sourcing used and near-new vehicles from China's domestic market for export. We help overseas dealers, importers, wholesalers and professional buyers find vehicles, compare specifications, request quotes and source specific vehicles.

Our focus is on vehicle sourcing and export — displaying available inventory, capturing sourcing requirements, and helping coordinate export preparation and shipping. Vehicle specifications and data are published alongside our listings, with a planned expansion into dedicated Data, Market and Tools resources.

We publish only the vehicle information we hold. Where a detail is not available, we say so rather than guessing. We do not publish sales figures, customer counts, certifications or rankings that we cannot substantiate.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — China Used Car Export
privacy.description: Privacy policy for China Used Auto Hub — what information we collect through enquiry forms, email and WhatsApp, and how we use it.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how {siteName} handles the information you provide when you use this website, including enquiry and request forms.

p: When you submit a quote or sourcing request, we collect the details you provide — such as your name, email, WhatsApp number, company, and the vehicle requirements you describe. We collect the same categories of information when you contact us by email or WhatsApp.
We use your information solely to respond to your enquiry and to provide the sourcing and export services you request. We do not sell your information or share it with third parties for marketing.
We keep enquiries only as long as needed to respond to you and to maintain a record of the conversation. This website is static and does not run advertising or analytics trackers.

You may ask us to access, correct or delete the personal data you have provided. We do not currently appoint a representative in any specific jurisdiction; our data practices are described here as they actually operate.
For privacy questions, email {email} or message us on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}.

terms.title: Terms — China Used Car Export
terms.description: Terms of use for China Used Auto Hub — service description, listings, buyer responsibilities and governing law.
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these terms. {siteName} provides a platform for sourcing and exporting used vehicles from China.

p: We help overseas dealers, importers, wholesalers and professional buyers find vehicles, compare specifications, request quotes and source specific vehicles. We help coordinate export preparation, documentation and shipping. We do not manufacture vehicles, carry out statutory inspection, or clear vehicles through your destination customs.

Vehicle listings, specifications and prices are provided for information. Prices may vary based on configuration, shipping, taxes and destination. Availability can change and is confirmed when you request a quote.
A listing does not guarantee availability. We confirm availability, price and export details with you before any order is placed.
You are responsible for confirming that a vehicle is eligible for import into your destination country and for paying any duties, taxes and other charges that apply.
Unless mandatory law in your jurisdiction provides otherwise, these terms and your use of this website are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China.
For questions about these terms, email {email}.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy — China Used Car Export
cookies.description: Cookie policy for China Used Auto Hub — the limited cookies this static site uses and how to manage them.
cookies.intro: This page describes the cookies used on this website.

p: This website is a static site and does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Any cookies set are limited to those required for basic site functionality.
We do not use third-party advertising trackers or cross-site tracking cookies.
You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Because this site uses only minimal functional cookies, disabling them should not affect your ability to browse it.
For questions about this cookie policy, email {email}.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer — China Used Car Export
disclaimer.description: General disclaimer for China Used Auto Hub — information is for reference and is not professional advice.
disclaimer.intro: The content on this website is provided for general information only.

p: The information on this website — including vehicle listings, specifications, prices, guides and market notes — is provided for general reference. We publish only information we hold and do not present it as professional advice.
Nothing on this website is legal, tax, financial, import or other professional advice. For decisions with legal or financial consequences, consult a qualified adviser in your jurisdiction.
Prices, specifications and availability may change at any time and are confirmed with you during the quote process.
Content on this website does not constitute an offer, an invitation to treat, or a binding commitment to sell or supply any vehicle or service.

vehicleListingDisclaimer.title: Vehicle Listing Disclaimer — China Used Car Export
vehicleListingDisclaimer.description: How to read vehicle listings on China Used Auto Hub, including demo and example inventory disclosure.
vehicleListingDisclaimer.intro: Vehicle listings on this website are compiled from information provided by the source.

p: Specifications, mileage, condition notes and asking prices are provided by the source or compiled from information we hold. Where a detail is not available, we say so rather than guessing.
Unless a listing states otherwise, vehicle information has not been independently verified by us. Always confirm details, condition and history before purchase.

The inventory currently shown on this website is demonstration data. These are example listings used to demonstrate how the platform works, and they are not real vehicles currently for sale. Each demo listing is labelled as demo data on its page. When real inventory is connected, this notice will be updated.

exportCompliance.title: Export Compliance — China Used Car Export
exportCompliance.description: Export compliance statement — buyer responsibilities for import eligibility, taxes, duties and regulations.
exportCompliance.intro: Exporting a vehicle from China and importing it into a destination country is subject to the laws of both countries.

p: You are responsible for confirming that a vehicle is eligible for import into your destination country, including age limits, drive-side rules, emission standards, duties, taxes and any licence or registration requirements.
We do not provide legal or regulatory advice. Market information on this website and on our Market sub-site is general guidance only.
Before relying on any market data, duty rates or regulations, verify them with the relevant authorities in your destination country. Figures can change and may differ from what is shown.

dataProtection.description: What data China Used Auto Hub collects through enquiry forms, email and WhatsApp, and how it is used and stored.
dataProtection.intro: This page describes the personal data we collect and how we handle it.

p: When you contact us — through the quote or request form, by email or by WhatsApp — we collect the details you provide, such as your name, email address, WhatsApp number, company and the vehicle requirements you describe.
We use your details only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the sourcing and export services you request. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.
Enquiries are stored only as long as needed to respond to you and to keep a record of the conversation. We do not run advertising or analytics trackers on this website.
